modelName: XGBoost NFIP claim damage fraction estimator
predictionTarget: buildingDamageAmount / buildingPropertyValue, conditional on historical NFIP claims
evaluationMethod: GroupShuffleSplit by floodEvent; unknown events remain grouped together
limitations: NFIP claims are not a random sample of flood-exposed buildings; outputs are conditional historical severity estimates, not damage probability.
Claims records may have missing/administrative values; missing numeric features use -1.
Richardson model inputs are synthetic scenario attributes.
